description: Negative news about a person or company from GDELT (global news index, 15-minute updates): articles that name the counterparty with a financial-crime theme (fraud, money laundering, sanctions, bribery and corruption, enforcement, terrorism financing, cyber, scam, insolvency). Returns adverse / possible / none with each article's title, date, source and link, counts by theme and by source. Use in KYC / KYB onboarding, periodic review and investigations. Prax reports headlines; it does not judge their truth.
name: screen_adverse_media
title: Adverse media
